observable: sigma(pp -> Z/gamma* -> ll), 60 < m_ll(LHE) < 120 GeV, sqrt(s) = 13 TeV, per lepton flavour, lepton universality

compatibility.definition: -2 ln(L_common / L_split): one mu_Z against one per channel, all NPs profiled

ee_electron_id_1p2.label: ee: ElectronID norm. #pm1.2%
ee_electron_id_1p2.note: diagnostic: the UL2016postVFP Medium-ID SF map (datasets/corrections, POG/EGM) gives +-0.3-1.6% per electron outside the ECAL gap, 1.2% per Z->ee event; inside 1.444 < |eta_SC| < 1.566, which z-ee does not veto, it is sf = 1 +- 1. Not a result: it uses a number z-ee did not deliver.

tautau_as_delivered.label: #tau#tau as delivered (no #tau_{h} ID p_{T} uncertainty)
tautau_as_delivered.note: the tautau likelihood exactly as z-tautau publishes it (1981 +73 -70 pb alone)

tautau_ptsplit.label: #tau#tau: p_{T}-split #tau_{h} ID SF model
tautau_ptsplit.note: z-tautau's cross-check model (l tau_h regions split at pT(tau_h) = 40 GeV, own scale factors below) in place of the nominal one: the effect TauIDpT_tautau stands for, fitted instead of assigned

tautau_emu_only.label: #tau#tau: e#mu channel only
tautau_emu_only.note: the sub-measurement without any tau_h (z-tautau: 0.960 +0.042 -0.040); docs/11 section 7.1

tautau_tauh_only.label: #tau#tau: #tau_{h} channels only
tautau_tauh_only.note: tau_h tau_h + mu tau_h + e tau_h with free scale factors, no e mu (z-tautau: 1.203 +0.091 -0.084); docs/11 section 7.1

tautau_emutrig2x.label: #tau#tau: e#mu trigger prior #times2
tautau_emutrig2x.note: the pre-review e-mu trigger prior (2 % per leg); docs/11 section 7.2

tautau_leptons_correlated.label: #tau#tau lepton NPs correlated
tautau_leptons_correlated.note: the name-based default the tautau group warned about: MuonID/Iso/Trigger/Scale of tautau (POG) shared with mumu (tag-and-probe), ElectronID/Reco/Scale shared with the normalisation parts of ee's ElectronID/ElectronRECO/ElectronES

tautau_theory_decorrelated.label: #tau#tau theory NPs decorrelated
tautau_theory_decorrelated.note: tautau constrains QCDScale through the acceptance ratios of its four final states; here that constraint cannot reach ee and mumu

ttbar_cr_for_all_channels.label: t#bar{t}: e#mu control region for all channels
ttbar_cr_for_all_channels.note: the free mu_ttbar that emu_CRtt determines also scales ttbar in mumu and ee, instead of their 6 % XS_TTbar prior

ttbar_xs_constrained.label: t#bar{t}: XS_TTbar (6%) everywhere, no free #mu_{t#bar{t}}
ttbar_xs_constrained.note: one 6 % XS_TTbar for all channels, constrained by emu_CRtt, no free factor: the control region then measures Lumi x XS_TTbar x e-mu trigger x b-tag, and its 10 % excess is shared out by prior width -- 0.3 sigma of it to Lumi, which moves every channel

mumu_cremu_validation.label: #mu#mu with mumu_CRemu as delivered (validation region)
mumu_cremu_validation.note: must reproduce the standalone mumu fit exactly: a VALIDATION region is not in the likelihood

mumu_cremu_control.label: #mu#mu with mumu_CRemu as a control region
mumu_cremu_control.note: what the e-mu region would add to mumu if it were fitted: the size of what is given up by leaving it to tautau
